## How it works

- [statement] The legacy `/query` workflow supplies the relevant collection schema to GitHub Copilot and asks the user to choose a collection when the prompt omits one. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-query.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant
- [statement] The historical /query workflow supplies relevant collection schema to Copilot, asks the user to select a collection when none is specified, and lets the user open generated queries in a playground or run them directly. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-query.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The legacy MongoDB Copilot participant generated MongoDB queries from natural language inside VS Code; Microsoft and a separate developer blog both described that integration. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant · also: https://code.visualstudio.com/blogs/2024/06/24/extensions-are-all-you-need, https://pascoal.net/2024/10/22/gh-copilot-extensions/
- [statement] MongoDB issue VSCODE-791 reports the literal `Copilot model not found` error for the participant, lists affected version 1.16.1, and records fix version 1.17.0; this is tracker metadata rather than an independently tested repair. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/VSCODE-791 · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The legacy participant documentation lists three specialized commands: `/query` for query generation, `/schema` for collection schema information, and `/docs` for documentation links. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant
- [statement] The legacy workflow let users run generated queries directly or open them in a playground; a separate Export Code to Playground action converted selected application queries into MongoDB shell syntax. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-query.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-export-test.md
- [statement] The v1.18.0 release notes list participant deprecation. The linked merged PR states that it removes the @MongoDB chat participant and leaves MCP as the only AI integration. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode/releases/tag/v1.18.0 · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant · also: https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode/pull/1361
- [statement] MongoDB’s participant-specific AI usage documentation warns that generative AI may give inaccurate responses. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/ai-data-usage.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant
- [statement] The documentation and release artifacts differ in scope: the overview still describes an included participant, while the v1.18.0 removal PR and release notes establish its deprecation/removal. Treat the command instructions as legacy guidance. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant · also: https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode/pull/1361, https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode/releases/tag/v1.18.0
- [statement] Historically, the MongoDB participant augmented GitHub Copilot Chat with MongoDB domain knowledge, natural-language query generation, collection schema information, and references to MongoDB documentation. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant · also: https://code.visualstudio.com/blogs/2024/06/24/extensions-are-all-you-need
- [statement] The historical documentation demonstrates invoking @MongoDB /query to generate an aggregation pipeline and then adding another stage through a follow-up prompt. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-query.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant
- [statement] The historical Export Code to Playground feature requires enabling the MongoDB Copilot extension. Selecting application query code and choosing MongoDB Copilot Extension > Export Code to Playground opens the selection in a new playground using MongoDB shell syntax. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/copilot-export-test.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant
- [statement] Microsoft's June 24, 2024 announcement described the MongoDB chat participant as a private preview requiring signup; this is historical launch status, not evidence of present availability. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-06-24) — https://code.visualstudio.com/blogs/2024/06/24/extensions-are-all-you-need · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code GitHub Copilot participant
